_meta.title: GridWise Independent Edge-Case Test Pack
_meta.origin: Original synthetic adversarial tests based on uploaded BUP GridWise problem statement and participant guide; NOT official judge cases.
_meta.usage: Send each valid[].input object as POST /optimize-energy. Match expected_interpretation and independently replay hourly_plan. For invalid[], POST input or raw_body and expect a controlled 400/422 response.
_meta.ground_truth: expected_interpretation excludes free-text explanation; the official judge does not byte-match explanation. reference_optimal_cost_bdt is independently solved LP cost, not a mandated schedule.
_meta.caveat: An edge-case label does not assert the organizer hidden tests will contain it, especially the zero-capacity battery case.
